main.description: Replace the author chips on a document, in the order given. Whoever may edit the document may. An author is an account (a DID) or a name with no account behind it, which is what 42 percent of them are.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such document, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller may read it but may not edit it.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: More than 16 authors, or one with neither a DID nor a name.
